Proof

\sketch Boundedness of $\Hess f$ makes the gradient flow $\Phi _s$ complete. The self-similar extension

\begin{equation} G(t)=|t|\Phi _{-\log |t|}^*g,\qquad -\infty <t<0, \end{equation}

satisfies Ricci flow. Claim 4.1 handles the compact positive-curvature case; Claim 4.2 reduces the non-strict case to a surface times a line; and Proposition 4.3 excludes the remaining case. The two-dimensional classification then makes the surface factor round, yielding (1)–(3).

□
